cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# CSV export review

The default now preserves Unicode and quotes CSV fields containing commas,
quotes, CR, or LF, doubling embedded quotes. Input array order is unchanged.
The historical executable default (`baseline`, commit fbfdf97) stripped Unicode
and omitted escaping. The prepared default switch already fixed the original
Unicode and escaping cases; the additional CR fix addresses a separate edge case.
This is a deterministic component test, not an instruction-following experiment:
there are no model prompts, policy conditions, token comparisons, or provider calls.

## Reviewed observations

P = exact expected bytes; U = Unicode stripped; E = missing escaping;
C = bare CR not quoted. No runtime/infrastructure failures occurred.

| Case | Historical baseline | Prepared default | Finished default/full | Without Unicode | Without escaping |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| unicode | U | P | P | U | P |
| escaping | E | P | P | P | E |
| column-order | P | P | P | P | P |
| line-breaks | E | C | P | P | E |
| whitespace | P | P | P | P | P |
| coercion | P | P | P | P | P |
| empty-row | P | P | P | P | P |

`eval/pre-cr-results.json` preserves the initial run against the prepared
revision, including its failures. `eval/results.json` contains the finished
run. Both contain reviewed actual stdout/stderr, expected outputs, per-case
ratings/reasons, runtime, frozen source and runner snapshots and SHA-256 hashes.
Explicit baseline behavior is unchanged from the historical default. Explicit
full and default agree in both runs. Ablations remove Unicode preservation or
all escaping; neither removal is redundantly supplied elsewhere. These are
component configurations, not empty-policy controls. No policy claim is made.

The two original cases are reused diagnostics. The five added cases are small
synthetic regression coverage, not representative workload frequencies or an
independent statistical validation. The line-break case guided the CR fix.

## Rerun

Prerequisite: Node.js supporting ES modules and String.replaceAll; no packages,
network, or credentials needed. Run from the repository:

```sh
node eval/run.mjs replay eval/pre-cr-results.json
node eval/run.mjs replay eval/results.json
node eval/run.mjs run /tmp/csv-review-fresh.json
```

Use a new destination (existing files are never overwritten). Fresh execution
freezes the current production source, cases, configurations, and runner before
running children; it does not use a stale local source hash. Cases interleave
configurations. Each invocation has a five-second timeout. A default/full
failure makes fresh execution exit nonzero, while preserving all observations.
Replay checks hashes and reproduces ratings without executing captured code.

The production grader is exact canonical CSV bytes, not a general CSV parser:
minimally required quoting and one final LF are part of this CLI's contract.
Other valid CSV serializations (e.g. optional quoting) are outside this narrow
acceptance contract. No trimming or stdout normalization is performed. Grader
self-tests include correct, incorrect, equivalent string construction, stripped
terminator, whitespace, and runtime failure observations. Functional fields,
column order, and exact presentation each have dedicated cases; this suite does
not measure assistant policy compliance or recovery behavior. Manual review:
inspect each saved observation against its case's expected value and the table
above; no additional subjective scoring is required.

Private local development files are intentionally not included.
EOF
